limitations: macOS CPU fixture; does not measure NVIDIA probes, CUDA synchronization or kernel/model search quality
No concurrent dashboard, archive or coordinator in this command microbenchmark
Historical jobs are database rows, not historical source/evidence trees
Pair 0 retained as first command pair; executable/runtime caches are not forcibly flushed
